beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Painted hands also preserve presence without supplying a complete explanation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These scenes slow the argument through attention to what remains unknown.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reading experience rewards patience with signs that refuse an immediate story.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The second part moves toward a larger settlement called Many Fires.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Stored grain changes what can wait and what people owe.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Strangers need rules that cannot depend entirely on personal memory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The scale of cooperation creates benefits as well as unfamiliar constraints.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book carries its earlier questions into these new arrangements.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Who knows enough to judge, and which differences does a rule conceal?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its city chapters extend the journey without abandoning the concrete language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Public explanations and private exceptions begin to occupy the same settlement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel examines debt, authority, labor, and stories that legitimate power.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also notices the real work that makes collective life possible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That balance keeps the city from becoming a simple warning symbol.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers encounter institutions through people trying to eat, work, and belong.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument grows through comparison rather than a sudden imported lecture.
